firmware.title: Quake II
firmware.author: Mikhail Matveev; id Software
firmware.description: id Software's 1997 shooter at 320x240, HDMI or I2S sound, 504 MHz. Needs the retail pak0-pak2 (3.20) in /quake2/baseq2.
firmware.controls: USB keyboard and mouse: arrows move, Ctrl fire, Space jump, Esc menu.
